paper.title_en: The Fuzzy-Sphere as a Black Hole in the IKKT Matrix Model: An Assessment
paper.abstract_en: Black-hole thermodynamics has been reproduced with remarkable success from the BFSS matrix model, but the corresponding test in the closely related IKKT matrix model has awaited its recently proposed finite-temperature formulation, within which we investigate this correspondence. Introducing a cubic Myers term, we compute the complete one-loop thermodynamics -- free energy, internal energy, entropy, and heat capacity -- of a fuzzy $S^2$ background, and compare against the D0 and D2 black holes as the closest available reference points, since no gravitational dual is known for this specific background. At fixed Myers coupling, the leading entropy exhibits an $O(N^3)$ scaling rather than the $O(N^2)$ behavior characteristic of conventional black holes. Holding the physical radius fixed instead yields a genuine $O(N^2)$ scaling, showing that the power of $N$ depends on the large-$N$ prescription and is therefore not by itself an unambiguous test of a black-hole interpretation. We further find no intrinsic Hawking temperature -- only a characteristic scale -- and a heat capacity that is negative at low temperature but positive at high temperature. The absence of an intrinsic Hawking temperature, tied to the missing gravitational dual rather than to the choice of large-$N$ prescription, persists in either scaling limit. Rather than establishing a black-hole interpretation of the finite-temperature IKKT matrix model, these results provide a quantitative benchmark against which future analytical, numerical, and holographic investigations can be tested.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在 IKKT 矩阵模型新提出的有限温表述下研究模糊 S^2 背景与黑洞热力学的对应，计算完整单圈热力学量并与 D0、D2 黑洞比较，直接关涉黑洞热力学与全息对偶，理论深度足够；结论强调熵的 O(N^3) 与 O(N^2) 标度依赖大 N 方案、缺乏内禀霍金温度，属定量基准而非确证性结论，清晰且具有参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 模糊球面作为 IKKT 矩阵模型中的黑洞：一项评估
decision.abstract_zh: 黑洞热力学已从 BFSS 矩阵模型中以惊人的成功被再现，但在密切相关的 IKKT 矩阵模型中，相应的检验一直在等待其最近提出的有限温表述，我们在此表述内研究这一对应关系。引入立方 Myers 项后，我们计算模糊 $S^2$ 背景的完整单圈热力学量——自由能、内能、熵和热容——并与 D0 和 D2 黑洞这一最近可用的参照点进行比较，因为对于该特定背景尚不存在已知的引力对偶。在固定的 Myers 耦合下，领头熵表现为 $O(N^3)$ 标度，而非传统黑洞所特有的 $O(N^2)$ 行为。若改为固定物理半径，则得到真正的 $O(N^2)$ 标度，表明 $N$ 的幂次依赖于大 $N$ 方案，因此其本身并非对黑洞解释的一个无歧义检验。我们进一步发现不存在内禀霍金温度——只有一个特征标度——以及一个在低温下为负、在高温下为正的热容。内禀霍金温度的缺失系于缺失的引力对偶而非大 $N$ 方案的选择，且在任一标度极限中均持续存在。这些结果并未确立有限温 IKKT 矩阵模型的黑洞解释，而是提供了一个定量基准，未来的解析、数值与全息研究可据此受到检验。
